year: Year the hurricane made landfall in the United States.
name: Name given to the hurricane.
masfem: Mean rating of the name on a masculine (1) to feminine (11) scale by nine coders.
min: Minimum central pressure at landfall in millibars.
gender_mf: 1 if the name is a female name, 0 if a male name.
alldeaths: Total number of deaths attributed to the hurricane.
ndam: Property damage in millions of dollars normalised to 2013 values.
masfem_mturk: Mean rating of the name on the same 1 to 11 scale by 32 online raters.
wind: Maximum sustained wind speed at landfall in miles per hour.
ndam15: Property damage in millions of dollars normalised to 2015 values.
